tributeSays.line: ⛓️ Aroha brings it home: Thornfield bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
🌾 Tribute wagons from Thornfield turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🗣️ Word with the traders: Thornfield sent another fire grain when their stores ran thin — no tribute, no ceremony, just food on the road. That's a thing villages DO now.

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.

◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)
